preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of queries Q for each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each query integer X must be a positive integer between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: For each query, the output must be two space-separated integers E and O representing the counts of elements with even and odd number of 1s in binary representation.
The sum of E and O must equal the total number of unique elements in the set S after each query.

postconditions.expression: all((x in S) for x in S)
postconditions.description: All elements in S must be unique and must have been inserted according to the query rules.

invariants.description: The size of the set S must not exceed 2^17 due to the maximum possible unique elements generated.

invariants.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in S)
invariants.description: All elements in the set S must be integers.
All elements in the set S must be non-negative integers.
